list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 27 hidden on PlayStation until earned.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing extra to do for it: finish the roadmap, then A Long Road, and this follows.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end and it unlocks. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the chapter-complete trophy unlocks. Do the Chapter 1 meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude before the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 2. (Some lists print this name with the middle word censored; Press Start prints the full uncensored form.) Once Chapter 2 is done you can switch characters, which opens the partner trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, the gold for finishing the game. Play the final mission to the end. Keep a manual save from before the final mission: there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission Breakfast Run and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the heist mission The Cartel Heist and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission Child's Play and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission Headliners and it unlocks.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission VCIA Takedown and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The gold for 100% completion, and the hardest trophy on the list. The checklist lives at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion; it only appears after the story, but progress you made earlier already counts, and nothing on it is missable. Work it after the finale: stunts, races, shooting-range golds, collectibles and the rest. Expect around 200 hours for the full platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts anywhere across Leonida. Stunts add up over the whole game, so just keep jumping, drifting and airing vehicles whenever you travel; mop up the remainder in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type at least once: 9 types in total. Work through the activities menu one by one in free roam; a single try of each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the range in free roam and work through the challenge list; retry any challenge until the gold score lands.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Fly the course cleanly and beat the target time at every spot; none of them is missable, so revisit any you lose.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race only counts once, so keep entering new ones rather than replaying a favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Find Cal at a fishing spot in free roam and win the challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any arcade game through to the end. Step up to an arcade cabinet in free roam and finish one full game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand. Follow Andy's missions to the last one and finish it. Stranger missions stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand. Follow Kenton's missions to the last one and finish it. Available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand. Follow Billy's missions to the last one and finish it. Available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 full strands of stranger missions around Leonida. Complete any 8 stranger-mission strands around Leonida.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand. Follow Randy's missions to the last one and finish it. Available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand. Follow Tyrone's missions to the last one and finish it. Available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at 18 spots across 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia. Lucia's balcony meditation is only available in Chapter 1 and disappears once the chapter ends, and there is no mission replay, so do every meditation spot open to you in Chapter 1 before moving on. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand. Track down the one-of-a-kind animal Bret asks you to hunt and take it down. Available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect and trade until three sets are complete. Nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Do the WAiNK It activity at 100 different locations. (The activity is spelled WAiNK in-game.) Work through the map in free roam; each new spot counts once.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges. Challenges tick over naturally as you play; check the challenge list in free roam and chase the easy ones to reach 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs both characters playable, so it opens from Chapter 2. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops together and escape. Breaking line of sight and hiding until the stars clear does it.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, once you can switch characters. With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the Wanted Level dropping: hit the green robbery icons one after another and keep the flashing Wanted Level the whole time. Take a few items per shop, and sticky bombs on the back-room safe help. It pops after you drive away from the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Drive anything new you see; each first-time vehicle counts. Exploring the whole map for The Goodtime State helps cover this too.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Pick a busy fight, trigger Combat Focus with several enemies in range, and take them down before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger plane docked at a VCIA boarding bridge, back it out to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away. The E3/E4 gate is the easiest one to reach. Driving through the airfield fence is quicker than going through the terminal, and the airfield planes themselves do not count.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank. Several sit unlocked in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, south of the map: drive in through the gate or over the stunt jump, climb in and drive off. Expect a 3-star Wanted Level on the way out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. Go in quiet, avoid the staff's line of sight and any cameras, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away clean each time. Plan the escape route before you go in, and repeat at different banks until the fifth getaway.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush one on the road, crack it open, take the cash and lose the cops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore the whole of Leonida. The map starts under fog and the trophy counts once none is left. A plane, available early in Chapter 1, clears the fog fastest, so start this in Chapter 1 and finish it while travelling.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from every gang: 9 gangs in total. Find each gang's operation, hit it and get out; work through the list in free roam.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order and enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach in free roam and take the cocktail option.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Crash a car out of a vehicle showroom through the window. Drive into a showroom, line up on the big front window and smash straight through it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The official description is a riddle that points at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, but no reliable method has been confirmed yet. Do not trust a guessed method: try the bowling alley in free roam and check back once players confirm how it triggers.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The official description is a riddle about a partnership, but no reliable method has been confirmed yet. Do not trust a guessed method: the hint points at some kind of partnership, and the trigger is still unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices across the game. Choices add up through missions, conversations and activities, so this ticks over naturally as you play; just keep choosing and it lands.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The official description is a riddle that says the second time works, but no reliable method has been confirmed yet. Do not trust a guessed method: whatever the first attempt is, the hint is that it takes a second try.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Find the UFO random encounter in Kelly County after 2am. A car with flickering lights waits at the roadside and the UFO shows up further up the road. Talk to the stranger, then go back to her car. Reported by players, not yet confirmed in every detail.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive past on a bike or in a car and swing a melee weapon as you pass; each knockdown counts.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies; pass them through your contacts until the total reaches $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops, all shops counted together. Clothes, weapons, food and cars all add to the total; buy big-ticket items late in the game to finish it off.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property: 8 in total. Save up and purchase each one as it becomes available; the last one finishes the trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you own or discover, open the app and register each one until you reach 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
